payload.core_mechanism_summary: Recursively compute max dollars from coin n by either selling it directly (if n<12) or exchanging into floor(n/2)+floor(n/3)+floor(n/4) with memoization.
payload.rationale: Solution uses a recursive function with a dictionary to memoize results for each n, a classic top-down DP approach, matching dp_memoized_recursion subtype.
